He told me ''you'' killed him!''"<br />"''No. ''I'' am your father.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] reveals to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] their shared heritage|<ref name="TESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''3 ABY''' was the third [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]].

This year was known as '''Year 1,003''' after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]].

==Events==
{{Quote|The Empire is coming unglued&hellip;|[[Tomaas Azzameen/Legends|Tomaas Azzameen]]|<ref name="XwA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>}}
*38:F1:1&mdash;[[New Year Fete Week/Legends|New Year Fete Week]].<ref name="GNN13">{{JournalCite|13|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
*38:1:29&mdash;[[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Bregius Golthan]] left [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="GNN13" />
*38:1&mdash;Contraband of [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]] products increased in the [[Spirva sector/Legends|Spirva sector]].<ref name="GNN13" />
*38:2:13&mdash;Premiere of ''[[The Kallea Cycle]]'' opera on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Jewel thief Tombat struck at an official Brentaal banquet few days earlier.<ref name="GNN13" />
*''The Kallea Cycle'' began its tour of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].
*[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] encountered a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during a mission to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="TFT">"[[The Final Trap]]"</ref>
*[[Scientist/Legends|Scientists]] rescued from [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] built a [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
*[[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] was [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|invaded]] and destroyed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]].<ref name="TESB" />
*[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] collected [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] bounty on Solo after delivering [[Gender/Legends|him]] [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encased]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].<ref name="TESB" />
*[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] began [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] under [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], only to end it in order to rescue his friends. He promised Yoda he would return, then went to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], where he lost a [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|duel]] with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="TESB" />
*The Empire [[Occupation of Bespin|annexed]] Cloud City, along with the rest of Bespin.<ref name="TESB" />
*At the [[Haven (rendezvous point)|Rebel rendezvous point]], Skywalker, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] began their [[Standard year/Legends|year]]-long quest to save Solo from being held frozen in carbonite by Jabba Desilijic Tiure in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TESB" />
*The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] settled at the temporary base of [[Golrath Station]] on [[Golrath/Legends|Golrath]], but, several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, were driven off by the Empire, due to the station's demolition by the Imperials.<ref name="Marvel">[[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'' (1977)]]</ref>
*After evacuating Golrath Station on Golrath, [[Haven Base]] on [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]] succeeded Echo Base on Hoth as the command center of the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Marvel" />
*The [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star's]] construction was moved from its unknown origin to the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].
*The Rebel Alliance violently, but secretly allowed by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], acquired the [[Death Star II plans|plans]] of the second [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="TESB" />
*The [[Ewoks (television series)|adventures]] of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], take place on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="Ewoks">[[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]</ref>
*[[Gaeriel Captison]] spent a year on [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]] doing postgraduate work on government.
*Skywalker and Organa restored [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Denid]] to the throne of [[Velmor/Legends|Velmor]].
*[[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] began to collapse.<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>
*The Empire brought an end to the [[Sepan Civil War]].<ref name="TIE">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>
*The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] finally recovered from its [[Destruction of Taris|devastation]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]].
*The [[Pimbrellan League]] was founded.
*[[Rascal Squadron]] destroyed the Imperial [[Arah mining facility]].
*The [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Terror]]'' was destroyed along with the [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE Phantom]] project at [[Imdaar Alpha]] by Rebel operatives.
*The [[Abridon refugee camp]] was razed.<ref name="FC">''[[Star Wars: Force Commander]]''</ref>
*Skywalker was captured by [[Brenn Tantor]] on [[Abridon/Legends|Abridon]].<ref name="FC" />
*Brenn Tantor defected to the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="FC" />
*One of the last surviving [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|remnant]] of the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] was [[Battle of Geonosis (Galactic Civil War)|destroyed]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="RS3">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>.
*The [[Towani family]] crash-landed on the Forest Moon of Endor.<ref name="CoC">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref>
*[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] constructed his own [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber/Legends|Lightsaber]].
